diagonal_physics.backing: Two real touching vertical faces. Ordinary sections require one centered 2x4-pixel contact pad on either vertical half; top/bottom slabs and suitable stair faces work. Source installations retain original full-face backing checks.

note: One ordinary ladder cell with no helpers; authored rail protrusions do not reserve neighbors. Cardinal collision remains thin; diagonals deliberately use one coarse rectangle. Visual, collision, selection and support are distinct contracts.
